questions.question: A Large Language Model (LLM) is created primarily by:
options: Training a simple neural network on a small dataset
Scaling the Transformer architecture and training it on massive text data

questions.question: Modern AI systems such as ChatGPT and Gemini are examples of:
Why do LLMs use tokens instead of full words?
options: To better understand parts of words and adapt to new language patterns

questions.question: In general, one token in English corresponds approximately to:
The word 'Cat' is typically represented as how many tokens?
Breaking the word 'Hamburger' into 'Ham', 'bur', and 'ger' demonstrates:
The Context Window of an LLM refers to:
options: The amount of information the model can process at once
The number of GPUs used during training

questions.question: If an LLM has a context window of 3000 tokens, it means:
options: It can remember roughly 3000 tokens at one time

questions.question: What happens if text longer than the context window is given to an LLM?
options: The AI ignores the middle section
The AI may forget earlier information

questions.question: Increasing the context window mainly helps an AI:
options: Understand larger documents without forgetting earlier parts

questions.question: A prompt in an LLM refers to:
options: The instruction or input given to the AI

questions.question: Which factor most strongly influences the quality of an AI-generated response?
Prompt Engineering refers to:
options: Designing better instructions for AI systems

questions.question: The KV Cache helps LLMs primarily by:
KV Cache is compared to 'sticky notes' because it:
options: Stores previously understood information for quick access

questions.question: Without KV Cache, generating each new token would require:
options: Re-reading the entire previous text repeatedly

questions.question: HuggingFace is best described as:
options: A social platform for AI models, datasets, and code

questions.question: AI engineers commonly use HuggingFace to:
The main advantage of using pre-trained models from HuggingFace is that developers:
options: Must always build models from scratch
Can start experiments without full training from the beginning

questions.question: Why is HuggingFace often compared to an 'App Store' for AI?
options: It hosts downloadable AI models, datasets, and tools
